affected_system: rights-preserving compliance assistance, incentives, inspections, and enforcement
alternatives: rank verified high-consequence candidates for rights-preserving compliance and assistance portfolio
select a risk-, equity-, and lifecycle-balanced portfolio for rights-preserving compliance and assistance portfolio
pair burden, effectiveness evidence, rights, equity, cost, and deliverability prioritization with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Eligibility, notice, awareness, capability, action, inspection, violation, sanction, and outcome remain distinct.
No behavioral score automatically triggers enforcement, benefit denial, or coercive action.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: fund only already-committed work for rights-preserving compliance and assistance portfolio.

constraints.description: The compliance, incentives, and behavioral policy prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: regulatory operations director and behavioral insights lead
decision_question: Which simplification, reminder, incentive, technical support, inspection, and accountability measures should be funded?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The compliance, incentives, and behavioral policy prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for rights-preserving compliance and assistance portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: burden, effectiveness evidence, rights, equity, cost, and deliverability prioritization
independence_key.primary_outcome: verified unresolved compliance burden and harm risk

intended_claim: A versioned prioritize design for comparing declared alternatives affecting rights-preserving compliance and assistance portfolio, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: verified unresolved compliance burden and harm risk
distributional gap in verified unresolved compliance burden and harm risk
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not report modeled compliance change as lawful behavior, public benefit, or welfare improvement.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for rights-preserving compliance and assistance portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.

title: Prioritize compliance assistance and policy redesign
transportability_risks: Law, administrative burden, trust, incentives, capability, enforcement, and baseline behavior differ.
Observed compliance may reflect detection and documentation rather than underlying behavior.
